questions.question: Explain dependency injection in Spring Boot.
questions.answer: Dependency injection is a design pattern in which the Spring IoC container manages object creation and provides dependencies to required components. Constructor injection is generally preferred because it supports immutability and easier unit testing.

questions.question: What are microservices?
questions.answer: Microservices architecture divides an application into independently deployable services. Each service handles a specific business capability and communicates through defined interfaces such as REST APIs or messaging systems.

questions.question: How would you handle a failure between two microservices?
questions.answer: I would examine service logs, distributed tracing and communication failures. I would apply appropriate timeouts and retries with backoff. For operations requiring reliability, I would consider circuit breakers and message-based communication. I would also ensure that failures are monitored and handled without creating inconsistent business transactions.
